summary: MON TERRITOIRE utilise le pipeline waypoint exclusif. Le mode viewport est complètement supprimé. Les zones apparaissent UNIQUEMENT autour des waypoints actifs.

data_flow: 2. zoneLockKey = useMemo(species + waypoint coords) — null if no waypoints
4. generateWaypointZonesV5(wp, zoom, layers, species) → backend API call
6. Features mapped to zones with positions, score, layerId
7. zoneLockRef.current = { locked: true, key, data } → STATE LOCKING
8. rawZones → allZones (clipping 1km if target) → bionicZones (layer+classification filter) → visibleZonesCount (score filter)
pipeline_architecture.currentMapBounds_usage: NOT used in zone pipeline (only in map rendering)
pipeline_architecture.currentZoom_usage: Read via ref for zoom level capping only

anti_regression_invariants.zones_stable_after_refresh: Zones reload on refresh (new effect cycle) — correct behavior
anti_regression_invariants.zones_stable_after_waypoint_change: Zones recalculate for new waypoint — correct behavior
